documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Disclosures under Reg. 10(6) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Notice of Postal Ballot

analysis.summary: Kovai Medical Center and Hospital Limited reported a 15.65% increase in operating income to Rs. 1,58,563.68 Lakhs for FY26, with an EBITDA margin of 29% and a PAT margin of 15%. The company inaugurated its new Institute of Neuro Sciences & OPD Block, representing a capital investment of Rs. 120 Crore. Additionally, the Board approved the construction of a new 300-bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises, with work expected to commence in the second quarter of 2026.

guidance.claim: The outpatient block is expected to be ready for operation by the end of the year.
guidance.quote: The OP block will be ready for operation by this year end.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's revenue growth in FY26 was driven by strong occupancy and higher average revenue per occupied bed.
demand_outlook.quote: The year 2025-26 continues to exhibit good performance, having posted a 16% growth in revenue against 12% in 2024-25, driven by strong occupancy and higher ARPOB (Average Revenue Per Occupied Bed).

demand_outlook.claim: Global healthcare demand is rising due to aging populations, medical technology advancements, and higher patient expectations.
demand_outlook.quote: As global healthcare demand continues to rise—driven by aging populations, rapid advancements in medical technology, and increasing patient expectations—healthcare providers are under mounting pressure to develop cutting-edge hospitals, clinics, and medical campuses within tighter budgets and accelerated timelines.

demand_outlook.claim: India's large population ensures a huge and growing demand for healthcare services.
demand_outlook.quote: Second-largest population globally ensures a huge and growing demand for healthcare services.

demand_outlook.claim: The rising incidence of chronic diseases is driving demand for specialized and preventive healthcare services.
demand_outlook.quote: Rising incidence of chronic diseases fuels demand for specialized care (e.g., cardiology, oncology) and preventive health programs focused on early detection and lifestyle management.

demand_outlook.claim: The medical college experienced significant growth with high demand for admission leading to all seats being filled.
demand_outlook.quote: The Medical College has experienced significant growth over the past years, with a substantial increase in patient intake. Their reputation has become so esteemed that there is now high demand for admission to this prestigious medical school, with all seats being filled.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board approved the construction of a 300-bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises.
capex_expansion.quote: The board has approved for constructing 300 bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises and the work may commence during the second quarter 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: The company inaugurated a new Institute of Neuro Sciences & OPD Block representing a capital investment of Rs. 120 Crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Representing a capital investment of ₹120 Crore, this state-of-the-art facility operates as a vertical hub of medical excellence.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested Rs. 47 Crore in advanced oncology and diagnostics, including Tamil Nadu's first Varian ETHOS AI-powered Adaptive Radiation Therapy system.
capex_expansion.quote: We launched Tamil Nadu’s first Varian ETHOS AI-powered Adaptive Radiation Therapy system, part of a ₹47 Crore investment in advanced oncology and diagnostics and continue to lead the state in performing CAR-T cell therapies.

capex_expansion.claim: Equipment investments during FY26 amounted to Rs. 11,845.14 Lakhs.
capex_expansion.quote: Investment in equipment during the year 2025-26 amounts to Rs. 11,845.14 Lakhs.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to add 100 beds to its main campus.
capex_expansion.quote: We will add another 100 beds in the main campus.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning a new 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition we are planning a 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested ₹ 3,358.36 Lakhs in equipment during the financial year 2024-25.
capex_expansion.quote: Investment in equipment during the year 2024-25 amounts to ₹ 3,358.36 Lakhs.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested ₹ 496.00 Lakhs in advanced medical equipment during the year 2024-25.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of its ongoing commitment to adopt cutting-edge medical technologies, your company made a significant investment of ₹ 496.00 Lakhs in advanced medical equipment during the year 2024–25.

capex_expansion.claim: The company inaugurated super-speciality facilities at the Sulur branch including added cath lab and MRI facilities.
capex_expansion.quote: The newly inaugurated super-speciality facilities at the Sulur branch of Kovai Medical Center now have added cath lab and MRI facilities.

capex_expansion.claim: Total investment in equipment during the financial year 2023-24 amounted to 5,239.02 Lakhs.
capex_expansion.quote: Investment in equipment during the year 2023-24 amounts to ` 5239.02 Lakhs.

margins_costs.claim: The hospital achieved an EBITDA margin of 29% and a PAT margin of 15% in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Your hospital has posted a robust EBITDA margin of 29%, which is excellent compared to the current industry standards, and has shown a sustained PAT (Profit After Tax) margin of 15%.

margins_costs.claim: Operating income for FY26 increased by 15.65% to Rs. 1,58,563.68 Lakhs.
margins_costs.quote: The income from operations for the financial year 2025-26 was Rs.1,58,563.68 Lakhs registering an increase of 15.65% over the previous year income of Rs.1,37,111.30 Lakhs.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for the year reached Rs. 46,710.23 Lakhs.
margins_costs.quote: Earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) were Rs.46,710.23 Lakhs over the previous year EBITDA of Rs. 40,781.69 Lakhs.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for FY26 was Rs. 24,446.00 Lakhs.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax (PAT) for the year was Rs.24,446.00 Lakhs over the PAT of Rs.20,894.62 Lakhs in year 2024-25.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved a profit margin of 15% in the financial year 2024-25.
Maintaining advanced medical equipment and skilled personnel involves significant ongoing expenses that can strain budgets.
margins_costs.quote: Maintaining advanced medical equipment, skilled personnel, and modern facilities involves significant ongoing expenses, which can strain budgets, especially amid intense market competition.

orders_capacity.claim: The orthopedic team completed 1,000 robotic-assisted knee replacement surgeries.
orders_capacity.quote: Our orthopedic team achieved the remarkable milestone of 1,000 robotic-assisted knee replacements so far using the CORI Advanced Robotic system.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a dividend of Rs. 15 per share for FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: Based on Company’s performance, the Board of Directors are pleased to recommend a dividend of ₹15/- per share (150%) for the Financial Year 2025-26 subject to the approval of the members.

capital_allocation.claim: The proposed dividend would result in a cash outflow of Rs. 1,641.34 Lakhs.
capital_allocation.quote: The dividend on equity shares, if approved by the members would involve a cash outflow of 1,641.34 lakhs.

capital_allocation.claim: The company does not propose to transfer any profits to reserves.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company does not propose to transfer any amount out of the profit to reserves.

capital_allocation.claim: The company did not undertake any one-time settlements with banks or financial institutions during the year.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company has not undertaken any one-time settlement with the banks or financial institutions during the year under review.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a 100% dividend of ₹ 10 per share for the financial year 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: Based on Company’s performance, the Board of Directors are pleased to recommend a dividend of ₹ 10/- per share (100 %) for the Financial Year 2024-25 for approval of the members.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is seeking approval to enhance its borrowing limits to ₹ 2,500 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: Therefore, it is considered desirable to enhance the borrowing limits to ` 2500 crore (Rupees Two thousand five hundred crore only) apart from temporary loans obtained / to be obtained by the company from its Bankers in the ordinary course of business.

capital_allocation.claim: The dividend payment involves a total cash outflow of 1094.23 lakhs.
capital_allocation.quote: The dividend on equity shares, if approved by the members would involve a cash outflow of ` 1094.23 lakhs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Registration of land and building valued at Rs. 5,931 Lakhs is pending due to disputes.
risks_headwinds.quote: The registration of land and building having a value of ` 5,931 Lakhs is pending due to disputes, as highlighted in Note 2 to the Financial Statements.

risks_headwinds.claim: The dispute regarding the registration of land and building is currently sub judice.
risks_headwinds.quote: The matter is currently sub judice.

risks_headwinds.claim: Lease agreements with a tenor of more than 11 months require registration with the Government of Tamil Nadu.
risks_headwinds.quote: All Lease Agreements with more than 11 months’ tenor, require registration with Department of Revenue, Ministry of Commercial Taxes and Registration, Government of Tamil Nadu.

risks_headwinds.claim: Attracting and retaining qualified healthcare professionals is a challenge due to competition and high work pressure.
risks_headwinds.quote: Attracting and retaining qualified healthcare professionals is challenging due to competition, high work pressure and quality of care.

risks_headwinds.claim: Increased reliance on digital systems exposes hospitals to data breaches, ransomware attacks, and IT failures.
risks_headwinds.quote: Increased reliance on digital systems makes hospitals vulnerable to data breaches, ransomware attacks, and IT failures, potentially compromising patient safety and data confidentiality.

risks_headwinds.claim: Economic downturns may reduce patient spending on elective procedures, affecting hospital revenues.
risks_headwinds.quote: Economic downturns may reduce patients’ willingness or ability to pay for elective procedures, thereby affecting hospital revenues and financial stability.

risks_headwinds.claim: The registration of land and building worth ₹ 5,931 Lakhs is pending due to subjudice disputes.
risks_headwinds.quote: The registration of land and building amounting to ` 5,931 Lakhs is pending on account of disputes which is highlighted in Note No 2 to the Financial Statements and the matter is subjudice.

risks_headwinds.claim: The registration of land and building worth ₹ 12,068.63 Lakhs is also pending.
risks_headwinds.quote: The registration of land and building amounting to ` 12,068.63 Lakhs is pending as highlighted in Note No 2 to the Financial Statements.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to commence construction work on the 300-bed Paediatric Hospital during the second quarter of 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The board has approved for constructing 300 bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises and the work may commence during the second quarter 2026.

management_commitments.claim: The company will complete the registration of the disputed immovable property once the matter is resolved.
management_commitments.quote: The Registration of the immovable property will be completed once the matter is resolved.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to complete the registration of land and building valued at Rs. 12,068.63 Lakhs in due course.
management_commitments.quote: The registration of land and building having value of ` 12,068.63 Lakhs would be completed in due course.

management_commitments.claim: The company will add 100 beds to its main campus.
management_commitments.quote: We will add another 100 beds in the main campus.

management_commitments.claim: The outpatient block will be ready for operation by the end of the year.
management_commitments.quote: The OP block will be ready for operation by this year end.

management_commitments.claim: The company is planning to start a new hospital in Chennai.
management_commitments.quote: We are planning to start a new hospital in Chennai.

management_commitments.claim: The upcoming neurosciences center will be the first of its kind in the region, equipped with state-of-the-art facilities.
management_commitments.quote: The upcoming neurosciences center will be the first of its kind in this region, equipped with state-of-the-art facilities.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated a focus on expanding the Department of Oncology and addressing existing gaps in medical care within the region.
management_commitments.quote: We are also focused on expanding the Department of Oncology and addressing any existing gaps in medical care within this region.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
